verdict.rationale: Hightouch's own AI Decisioning documents reinforcement-learning agents that learn the best message, channel, and timing per customer. Each agent combines an audience, goals, messages, scheduling rules, and guardrails, and the system 'measures what worked'. However, the docs frame the output as recommendations that marketers review before launch. They also never explicitly evidence lift measurement against a control. missing for 10: explicit measurable-lift reporting (holdouts/incrementality), clear evidence of fully autonomous execution rather than recommend-and-review, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI decisioning agents pick messages, timing, and channels per customer autonomously within guardrails I set, with measurable lift

citations.quote: AI Decisioning uses reinforcement learning to recommend the best message, channel, and timing for each customer, then measures what worked.
Each agent combines everything a campaign needs to learn and improve: an audience, goals, messages, scheduling rules, and guardrails.
AID learns which message, channel, and timing perform best for each person.
